title: Long-term training continually fine tunes motor memories
titleZh: 长期训练持续微调运动记忆
abstract: Nature Human Behaviour, Published online: 11 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41562-026-02637-8 Humans’ rapid adaptation to new dynamics is a crucial ability for interacting with the world. By combining the controlled manipulations of sensorimotor adaptation studies with the long-term learning approach of complex tasks, this study shows that the learned motor memory is continually tuned, and that retention increases with long-term training.
